servinfosub.title: Step 1: DTC Check
servinfosub.ptxt: Check DTC stored in central gateway control module memory.

ptxt.emph: In case that current DTC is detected:

servinfosub.ptxt: Perform applicable DTC troubleshooting for current DTC and repair or replace faulty parts.

ptxt.emph: In case that history DTC is detected:

s1.ptxt: Record DTC and then clear DTC once.

Referring to “circuit diagram” and “trouble area” in applicable DTC troubleshooting, check related parts that are prone to cause intermittent trouble (e.g. wire harness, connector, etc.) for detected history DTC.

servinfosub.title: Step 2: Final Confirmation Test
servinfosub.ptxt: Check that the problem symptom has gone and CAN communication system is free from any abnormal conditions. If what has been repaired is related to malfunction DTC, recheck DTC and check that no DTC is indicated.
